title: Northbridge Formulary Drug List by Formulary
content:
Every drug on the Northbridge Rx drug master list carries one status code on each formulary of the Formulary Benefit:

- **1 to 5**: the drug is covered at that member cost-share tier;
- **NF**: the drug is non-formulary;
- **EX**: the drug is a plan exclusion. It is never covered and it cannot be excepted.

The columns below are the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary, Northbridge Standard Formulary, Northbridge Preferred Drug List, Northbridge Broad Formulary and Northbridge Open Formulary.

## Reading the list

- A drug's status for a member is the code in the column of the formulary that the member's assignment holds on the date of service.
- Specialty tiers are tier 4 on the four-tier formularies (Exclusive and Value) and tiers 4 and 5 on the five-tier formularies.
- *Example from the list:* Lantus is NF on the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, tier 3 on the Value, Standard and Preferred Drug List formularies and tier 2 on the Broad and Open formularies. Wegovy and Zepbound are EX on the four most restrictive formularies and tier 3 on the Broad and Open formularies.
- *Example of a biosimilar preference as the codes show it:* on the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary the interchangeable glargine biosimilar insulin glargine-yfgn is tier 2 while the reference brand Lantus is NF.
